intent: Index GDScript for Trail and enforce Godot module boundaries and headless checks, validated against the 2026-11-18 one-shot experiment.

requirements.REQ-GD-A: A GDScript file builds into a Trail graph with a file node plus class and function definition nodes from the patched breadth-tier registry row and tags query.
requirements.REQ-GD-B: The postinstall applier restores the registry row and tags query in the shared Trail installation and is idempotent.
requirements.REQ-GD-C: The boundary checker approves declared cross-file GDScript dependencies and rejects undeclared ones with exit code 1.
requirements.REQ-GD-D: The headless check adapter runs a configured command and reports exit code, output and timeout failures.
